integrity: Proof self-contained except standard Weyl-character orthogonality, which is stated and invoked explicitly. Finite checks for q=3,5,7,9 reproduce counts; infinite family proved algebraically. No independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime powers only. Two-window minimality holds for full complex-matrix linear tomography among systems with each window supported on at most q points; no one-window pure-state impossibility or globally optimal condition number is asserted. Priority is a best-knowledge comparison, not independently certified.
title: Two transverse parabola windows form a sharp five-level Gabor tomography frame
